card.name: Small words inside purpose or advice clauses
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, a, of, want or he right after a verb or conjunction that opens an instruction or hypothetical clause. Examples are 'instruct spiders not to', 'likelihood that a' and 'advised of'.

modes.label: Infinitive after instruction
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'want' follows a verb of instructing or deciding, before the action.
modes.example: webmasters can instruct spiders not<< to>> crawl certain files or directories

modes.label: Word after 'that' or 'so that'
modes.description: An article or pronoun starts the clause after 'that' or 'so that'.
modes.example: PageRank estimates the likelihood that<< a>> given page will be reached by a web

modes.label: Advised of
modes.description: The word 'of' follows 'should be advised' in a caregiver warning.
modes.example: Families and caregivers should be advised<< of>> the need for close observation and communication with
